reason: My register has never failed me. I know every bill and every regular customer in it, so I don't see why I should pay ₹5,000 plus ₹1,000 every month for an app to do what my notebook already does.
objection: I already lost two good stylists last year. If I now make the rest take a selfie to check in and bill everything on their phone, they'll think I'm watching them like a thief and they'll go to the salon next door too.
would_change_my_mind: Drop the selfie check-in and staff tracking, and give me only the WhatsApp reminders and prepaid wallet for my customers at around ₹300-400 a month with no setup fee, so I can try it without upsetting my staff.
